candidate.name: Jane Doe
candidate.verdict: The resume demonstrates a solid internship where you built and optimized Node.js APIs with measurable latency reductions, a deployed full‑stack project serving hundreds of users, and strong algorithmic practice reflected by an 1800 LeetCode rating. Front‑end and cloud‑ops experience are only listed without proof.
candidate.assumption: Assumed the candidate targets entry‑level software engineering roles and no specific JD was provided.

composite.note: Balanced strengths in backend development and algorithmic skills, but limited evidence for frontend and cloud operations.
